changelog.title: Fixed
items: **Live Island offset crash.** The island offset slider allows -40 to 40 dp, but the pill passed `8.dp + offset` into `Modifier.padding`. Any offset below -8 dp produced a negative padding value and crashed Compose during layout (`IllegalArgumentException: Padding must be non-negative`) whenever a lyric pill was visible. The pill now keeps its 8 dp baseline padding and applies the user's offset as a visual `Modifier.offset`, which accepts negative values and preserves the full slider range.
